item.title: Meta FAIR Self-Improving Memory Hits 56.0 on Continual Learning Bench
item.description:
Meta FAIR’s Self-Improving Memory lets Kimi-K2.6 write its own LOAD and OFFLOAD memory prompts, then distills them into its weights. Optimized prompts score 56.0 versus 44.6 for the best hand-written harness on Continual Learning Bench.

item.title: Perplexity Launches Orchestrator API for Failover and Model Routing
item.description:

item.title: New LoRA Adapter Lifts Qwen3.8 Coding Success From 39% to 65%
item.description:

item.title: SID AI Releases SID-2 Agentic Search Model With 0.720 NDCG Swarm Mode
item.description:
SID AI released SID-2, an agentic search model trained with reinforcement learning. A single agent reaches 0.585 NDCG in 3.11 seconds, and a 12-agent SID-2 Swarm scores 0.720 NDCG, above GPT-6 Astra on SID’s benchmark.

item.description:
